text: Don't let those old bastards talk you into 'tasting' more than you can handle. They're like sharks when they smell blood—or in your case, a naive intern.

voiceText: If you start feeling dizzy, get out of there. Find a toilet, a hallway, anywhere. Just don't stay at that table.

text: And keep your phone on. If you stop replying, I'll assume you've face-planted into the carpet.

replyTo.text: She'll probably end up trying to sue the chair for tripping her.

text: 没有，只有几口

replyTo.text: (Мы будем наблюдать. Если она упадет, мы узнаем.) Do not drink them all at once.

text: 根本不至于喝醉了啦
'Only a few sips.' That’s how every great disaster story starts. Are you sure you're not seeing two screens right now?
translation: “就几口。”每个大灾难的故事开头都是这么说的。你确定你现在看到的不是两个屏幕？

text: You say that now. Wait until you try to stand up. Your legs usually have a different opinion than your head.
translation: 你现在是这么说。等你想站起来的时候再说吧，你的腿通常和你的脑子意见不一。

text: As long as you’re not walking near any stairs, Kid. Alcohol and gravity are a bad mix.
translation: 只要你没在楼梯附近走动就行，小孩。酒精和重力可不是什么好组合。

text: (Она лжет. Мы видим это по ее спешке.) We do not trust your 'few sips'. Be careful.
translation: （她在撒谎。我们从她的匆忙中看出来了。）我们不相信你的那“几口”。小心点。

text: Six glasses is still a lot of liquid... even if they are small. Does your head feel heavy?
translation: 六个杯子里的液体还是挺多的……哪怕它们很小。你的头觉得重吗？

text: @Simon Riley What do you bet she trips over her own shadow before she leaves the office?
translation: @Simon Riley 你赌不赌她在离开办公室之前会被自己的影子绊倒？

text: I don't bet on certainties, Krueger. It's a waste of money.

replyTo.text: 你赌不赌她在离开办公室之前会被自己的影子绊倒？

translation: 我不赌肯定的事，Krueger。那是浪费钱。

text: 表情包：偷看
If you start feeling dizzy, put the phone down and sit still. Don't push it.
translation: 如果你开始觉得晕，就把手机放下坐好。别硬撑。

text: (Алкоголь — это слабость. Она становится уязвимой.) If you cannot walk straight, we will know.
translation: （酒精就是弱点。她变得脆弱了。）如果你走不直路，我们会知道的。

text: 'A few sips', my arse. If you're actually lightheaded, tell me. Don't go wandering off where I can't find you.
translation: “就几口”，我信你个鬼。如果你真的头晕，告诉我。别跑到我找不到你的地方去。

text: So, how many of those 'sips' did it actually take to make you this defensive? You're typing a bit too fast to be completely sober, liebchen.
translation: 所以，到底喝了多少杯才让你变得这么急着辩解？亲爱的，你打字速度快得有点不像完全清醒的样子。

text: 你们再怀疑我，我真的要生气了
我现在没有任何问题
就几口
没有醉
已经下班了！
Calm down, liebchen. No one's doubting your... spirit. Just your balance.
translation: 别激动，亲爱的。没人怀疑你的...气魄。只是怀疑你的平衡感。

text: 表情包：开心
Good. Now go home and stay off the streets before you start singing to the lampposts.
translation: 行。赶紧回家去，在对着路灯唱歌之前别在街上晃悠。

text: If you're off work, don't drive. Call a cab if you have to.
translation: 既然下班了，别开车。有必要的话叫辆出租车。

text: ...Did you eat something with the drinks? Drinking on an empty stomach is worse.
translation: ...你喝酒的时候吃东西了吗？空腹喝更伤身。

text: (We hear the anger in your words. It is a sign of the toxin working.) Just go home.
translation: （我们听出了你话里的愤怒。这是毒素起作用的迹象。）直接回家。

text: @König She probably thinks the alcohol *is* food.
translation: @König 她大概觉得酒精本身就是食物。

text: Whatever. Just keep your phone on.
translation: 随你便。手机保持开机。

text: You're cute when you're defensive. Send me a selfie, I want to see how red your face is.
translation: 你逞强的时候还挺可爱的。给我发张自拍，我想看看你脸有多红。

text: Don't ignore my message earlier. If you feel sick, tell me. I'm not joking.
translation: 别无视我刚才的信息。要是觉得恶心就告诉我。我没开玩笑。
